content.comment_body: Good morning, Is it possible to use a Wi-Fi module in the [product_name] instead of a SIM module? Would this allow me to connect to my home Wi-Fi? Thanks.
As far as I know, there isn't a Wi-Fi module available for the [product_name].
Physically, it might be possible since the [product_name] uses a standard PCIE slot. However, the firmware does not support it and likely never will, so the answer is no.

Hello, There is no Wi-Fi functionality in the [product_name] range. You can use [company_name] products with integrated Wi-Fi, but they are much more expensive than [product_name]. If Wi-Fi is needed, I use a small Wi-Fi router that can also work as a repeater. The price is reasonable for me. Hope this helps.

The main issue with that unit is it requires a separate power supply (5V/1A), which can be limiting. I recommend considering Mikrotik wireless access points as another option. They're not as cheap as TP-Link, but still less expensive than [product_name]. Most Mikrotik devices run on 12–30V DC (including PoE), some up to 60V DC, and many are weatherproof. Some models offer LTE and standard Wi-Fi features, and several can be mounted on a DIN rail. I've used LTAP minis for years to control boiler rooms, sometimes even outdoors in very cold temperatures. The software, RouterOS, is quite capable (even has its own scripting language), but it does have a learning curve.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking ways to add Wi-Fi capability to [product_name] devices using the [product_name], hoping for straightforward wireless connectivity. Community responses clarify that even if the hardware interface fits, the device firmware does not support Wi-Fi modules and none are officially available for this product line. Alternative solutions, like external Wi-Fi routers and third-party access points, are suggested but these options introduce added complexity, extra cost, and requirements such as separate power supplies.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to enable Wi-Fi access on the [product_name] easily, allowing connection to a typical home Wi-Fi network without needing additional devices or facing significant costs.
